# Introduction

Welcome to the Example Docs Site, a small documentation project used to
exercise das-cli's end-to-end slicing pipeline.

## Overview

This site is intentionally small: a handful of guides and a large API
reference, structured the way a typical Docusaurus project is laid out.

## Next Steps

Continue to the installation guide to get the example CLI running locally.
